title: The Temporal Residual: Fast and Effective Retrofitting of Latent Feedback into Pretrained Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A transformer language model computes a deep hidden state for every token but uses it only to sample that token. Existing latent-feedback designs, which feed hidden states back across tokens, are mostly built in during pretraining and gain little when added to a pretrained model. We introduce the temporal residual, a second residual stream that every sublayer reads and writes and that is carried from each token to the next. It adds 2,752 parameters to a 4.2B-parameter model and starts exactly at the pretrained network. Retrofitted onto Qwen3.5-4B-Base with 5B tokens of training, it beats a standard model trained on the same data by 7, 13 and 5 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, writes shorter solutions, and stays ahead at matched training compute. translated_title: 时间残差：将潜在反馈快速有效地加装到预训练语言模型中
translated_abstract: Transformer语言模型为每个token计算深层隐藏状态，但仅将其用于采样当前token。现有的潜在反馈设计将隐藏状态跨token反馈传递，但这些设计大多需要在预训练期间构建，在预训练模型上添加时收益甚微。我们提出了时间残差，这是一条第二残差流，每个子层都可以对其进行读写，并将其从每个token传递到下一个token。它仅为一个42亿参数的模型增加了2,752个参数，并且完全从预训练网络出发。通过50亿token的训练将其加装到Qwen3.5-4B-Base上后，它在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和AMC 2023上分别比使用相同数据训练的标准模型高出7分、13分和5分，同时能写出更简短的解答，并在相同训练计算量下保持领先。使用独立的残差流至关重要：将状态馈入现有残差流的先前设计在加装时最多只能恢复40%的收益。验证损失可能会产生误导：……
tldr: 提出“时间残差”结构——一条仅需2,752个参数的第二残差流，可在预训练后直接加装到语言模型中，实现跨token的隐藏状态潜在反馈传递，显著提升数学推理性能并产生更简短的解答。
en_tdlr: The temporal residual is a lightweight second residual stream (only 2,752 extra parameters) that carries latent feedback across tokens and can be retrofitted into pretrained language models, significantly boosting math reasoning performance while producing shorter solutions.
